input.title: Skip trailing blank lines when parsing statements
input.body:
File: src/ingest/parser.ts

parseStatement only strips a single trailing empty line (from the final newline), but statements that end with an actual blank line after the last transaction leave one more empty-string line in the array. That line is parsed as a data row with a single empty field, which doesn't match the header length, so assertShape throws errors.rowShape at the row just past the last transaction. Skip or trim trailing (and ideally any wholly blank) lines before parsing rows so files with a blank line at the end import successfully.

label: bug
file: src/ingest/parser.ts

parseStatement only removes a single trailing empty line produced by the file's final newline. A statement that ends with an actual blank line after the last transaction leaves one more empty-string entry in the lines array; that gets parsed as a row with one empty field, which doesn't match the header's column count, so assertShape throws errors.rowShape at the row just past the last transaction. The fix is to skip trailing (or any wholly) blank lines before parsing data rows.

text:
Triaged issue-4406:

- **Label:** bug
- **File:** `src/ingest/parser.ts` — `parseStatement` only strips one trailing empty line (from the final newline); a genuine blank line after the last transaction leaves an extra empty-string entry that fails the column-count check in `assertShape`, raising `errors.rowShape` at the row just past the last real transaction.
- **PR:** pr-44 opened on `repomind/issue-4406`, proposing to skip trailing blank lines before parsing rows.
- **Comment:** posted explaining the root cause.
